Type: lamp
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Mid-Century Modern Plug-In Light Wall Mounted Sconce - 11 x 8 x 16.5 Inches, Black and Brushed Nickel
Colors: Black/Brushed Nickel
Materials: Metal
11"W x 8"D x 16.5"H Black metal shade, brushed nickel arm and wall plate Convenient plug-in sconce provides soft light. Rotary on/off switch. Bulb not included Easily assembled and mounted on wall Intended for indoor use only This mid-century modern wall sconce is sleek and easy to install. Just mount on the wall and plug the cord into a standard outlet. With a black metal cone shade and brushed-nickel hardware, it will brighten up any room or reading area.
